data.title: Terrain Tiles on AWS (terrarium encoding, zoom 7)
data.author: Mapzen / Linux Foundation; includes SRTM and GMTED (NASA/USGS), ETOPO1 (NOAA) and other public sources
data.license: Public data; attribution to the underlying sources required (see the dataset's attribution page)
data.used_for: Mean land elevation and sea depth per map block in data/elevation.json (2D relief and the 3D view)

notes: Trees and rice paddies are generated for looks; elevation is real but averaged over 4.4 km blocks.
District landmark items are hand-picked for well-known districts; the rest are chosen from real elevation, coastline and region.
Province items, pixel sprites and descriptions are original to this project.
